renderpass.name: Buffer A
renderpass.code: void mainImage(out vec4 c, in vec2 p) { vec2 uv=p/iResolution.xy; vec2 q=0.5+0.3*vec2(cos(iTime*2.0),sin(iTime*3.0)); float d=length((uv-q)*vec2(iResolution.x/iResolution.y,1)); vec3 old=texture(iChannel0,uv).rgb*0.96; c=vec4(max(old,palette(iTime)*smoothstep(0.06,0.0,d)),1); }

renderpass.name: Image
renderpass.code: void mainImage(out vec4 c, in vec2 p) { c=texture(iChannel0,p/iResolution.xy); }
